source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 4.3, printed page 79, with the sample problems worked and a self-check.

blocks.title: Molar volume
blocks.text: STP (standard temperature and pressure, yani 0 °C aur 1 atm) par kisi ideal gas ke ek mole ka volume (jagah) molar volume kehlata hai.

Is ki value 22.414 dm³ hai, jise aam taur par 22.4 dm³ le lete hain. Ise Vₘ se likhte hain. Molar volume ki madad se STP par gas ka mass ya moles volume mein badal sakte hain, aur volume se mass ya moles bhi nikal sakte hain.

blocks.title: Avogadro’s law
blocks.text: “Ek hi temperature aur pressure par sab ideal gases ke barabar volumes mein molecules ki tadaad barabar hoti hai.”

Yahi baat yun bhi keh sakte hain: 0 °C (273.15 K) aur 1 atm pressure par ideal gas ke ek mole ka volume 22.414 dm³ hota hai. Ek mole mein Avogadro’s number particles hote hain, is liye STP par kisi bhi ideal gas ke 22.414 dm³ mein 6.02 × 10²³ molecules hote hain.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab mein STP ka temperature 273.16 K likha hai. STP ka temperature 0 °C = 273.15 K hai; 273.16 K pani ka triple point hai.
STP par gas ka 22.4 dm³ = gas ka molar mass (grams mein) = 6.02 x 10²³ particles = 1 mole.

items: STP par 22.4 dm³ CO₂ = 44.0 g CO₂ = 6.02 x 10²³ molecules = 1 mole
STP par kisi bhi gas ka 22.4 dm³ = grams mein molar mass = 6.02 x 10²³ molecules = 1 mole
STP par 22.4 dm³ H₂ = 2 g = 6.02 x 10²³ molecules = 1 mole
STP par 22.4 dm³ NH₃ = 17 g = 6.02 x 10²³ molecules = 1 mole

blocks.text: Agar gas ke moles maloom hon to un ko molar volume se multiply kar ke gas ka volume nikal lete hain:

blocks.latex: \text{Volume of a gas} = \text{Number of moles} \times \text{Molar volume}
blocks.text_alt: Volume of a gas = Number of moles x Molar volume

blocks.title: Sample Problem 4.7
blocks.problem: STP par chlorine molecules ke 2.5 moles ka volume nikalein.

blocks.title: Sample Problem 4.8
blocks.problem: STP par 4.75 mol methane (CH₄) gas ka volume dm³ mein kitna hai?

blocks.prompt: Sochiye: 4 g He, 17 g NH₃ aur 64 g SO₂ STP par har ek 22.4 dm³ jagah kyun lete hain, halanke in ke molecules ka size aur mass bohat alag hai?
blocks.explanation: Har ek apni gas ka 1 mole hai, is liye har ek mein 6.02 x 10²³ molecules hain. Avogadro’s law ke mutabiq ek hi temperature aur pressure par molecules ki barabar tadaad barabar volume leti hai; ideal gas ka volume molecules ki tadaad par depend karta hai, un ke size ya mass par nahi.

items: Molar volume Vₘ: STP par 1 mole ideal gas = 22.414 dm³ (taqreeban 22.4 dm³).
STP par 22.4 dm³ gas = 1 mole = 6.02 x 10²³ molecules = grams mein molar mass.
